verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a cloud AI agent platform that stores user data, conversations and artifacts, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents retention settings, retention periods, or user- or admin-driven deletion of stored data. The 'deleting records' human-in-the-loop item is about gating agent actions in external tools, not Gumloop's own data retention, so it does not count here.
